layers.name: Console
layers.head: Tracks that know about each other
layers.body: Set each strip to Stem, Bus or Master and it links with the strips on other tracks. The Rail Link meter lights when the link is live.

layers.name: Rail
layers.head: Shared flow between instances
layers.body: Rail coupling passes level and energy between linked strips, so the mix moves together like one console.

layers.name: Neural
layers.head: Bring your own captures
layers.body: Swap the Console's built-in saturation for a neural capture. Load .nam or .json capture files through the tone browser, or import files and packs. Drive sets how hard the capture is hit; Mix blends it against the Console's own saturation. No captures are included.

layers.name: Dynamics
layers.head: Voicings, or build your own
layers.body: Pick a compressor voicing, or switch to CUSTOM and assemble one from 35 parts in seven slots. Many of the parts are fitted to measurements of real units.

layers.name: EQ
layers.head: Classic curves, band by band
layers.body: Bells and shelves follow curves fitted to measurements of classic EQs. In CUSTOM, each of the four bands takes its own part.

layers.name: Finisher
layers.head: Colour, tape and clipping
layers.body: Lysium adds preamp-style colour: even or odd harmonics, low-end weight, treble that softens with level. Logos is a tube-style saturator, A-Roll a tape stage, Tarus a clipper, and Kill a clipper at the output. Lysium, Logos, Tarus and Kill oversample up to 16x; tape does not.

layers.name: Limiter
layers.head: True-peak limiting
layers.body: Three modes for three jobs. Driven 18 dB past full scale, the output still stops at the −1 dBTP ceiling.

layers.name: Filter types
layers.head: Twelve filters of our own design
layers.body: Drive, Bite, Comb +, Comb −, Formant, Twin, Wave, Fold, Square, Crush, Ladder and Cascade. A Movement section (envelope, LFO and follower) sweeps the cutoff.

layers.name: Modes
layers.head: Eight modes
layers.body: Drive, Bite, Twin and Wave offer LP 24, LP 12, BP 12, HP 12, HP 24, BP 24, Notch and All-pass. Bite builds its 24 dB modes from two stacked state-variable stages, with a clipped resonance.

layers.name: Resonance
layers.head: A peak that sings
layers.body: Resonance raises a peak at the cutoff, and on the Drive filter the bass thins as it rises. The measurements below show the curves.

layers.name: Comb ±
layers.head: Two combs in one
layers.body: Crossfade from a feedforward comb to a feedback comb, with a soft ceiling in the feedback loop to keep it under control.

layers.name: Stage order
layers.head: Six orders
layers.body: Filter, Chorus and Delay run in one of six orders, picked from a list. Chorus has four styles; the delay is set in note lengths, with feedback, tone and ping-pong.

layers.name: Drive
layers.head: Drive and a soft ceiling
layers.body: Drive pushes the signal into one of nine saturation curves. The output ends in a soft ceiling, with an optional Auto Gain. Oversampling on the filter can be Off, 2x, 4x or 8x.

layers.name: Engine A
layers.head: Ten shapes
layers.body: Pick a shape and set Drive and Bias. The scope draws the transfer curve live as you turn them.

layers.name: Engine B
layers.head: The same ten shapes, picked independently
layers.body: Engine B offers the same ten shapes as Engine A, with its own selector and controls. Diode bends harder on one side than the other; Rectify moves from half-wave to full-wave as you raise Bias.

layers.name: Routing
layers.head: Five ways to wire them
layers.body: Serial, Parallel, Stereo (A left, B right), Mid/Side (A mid, B side) or Band Split (A low, B high), with a feedback loop around the pair.

layers.name: Oversampling
layers.head: Clean at the top
layers.body: Quality sets oversampling from 1x to 8x, so hard-driven tones alias less. The Crush shape is the exception: it aliases on purpose.

layers.name: Capture
layers.head: A capture after the engines
layers.body: Load a neural capture (.nam) of an amp or pedal to follow the two engines, with a gate and a tight, mid and bright voicing in front of it.

layers.name: Cab
layers.head: Two cabs, blended
layers.body: Load two cab impulse responses and blend between them, with low and high cuts.
layers.spec: Cab A / B · low cut · high cut

layers.name: Units
layers.head: Six units, fitted to measurements
layers.body: Each unit is our own reverb, fitted to the measured decay and colour of a classic digital reverb: Megha, Guha, Vayu, Dvaya, Valuka and Adi. The plots below show their reverb time band by band.
layers.spec: Megha · Guha · Vayu · Dvaya · Valuka · Adi

layers.name: Converters
layers.head: Optional vintage converters
layers.body: Set Converters to Vintage and a unit adds the word length, word noise, idle floor and DC of vintage converters, so quiet tails fade into a floor. It is on Megha (on by default), Valuka and Adi (off by default).

layers.name: Slots
layers.head: Three slots in a row
layers.body: Early, Mid and Late each hold any unit and feed the next. Each slot has pre-delay, width, low and high cuts, shimmer and freeze. Late is always on; Early and Mid start switched off.

layers.name: Wet bus
layers.head: Shape the wet signal
layers.body: After the slots come a four-band wet EQ, ducking, chorus and a fidelity control, with presets and A/B to compare settings.

layers.name: No colour
layers.head: No grain added
layers.body: Shunya's units add no saturation, drive or converter grain of their own. That is what transparent means here: the space, with nothing layered on top.

layers.name: Units
layers.head: Six units, fitted to measurements
layers.body: Each unit is our own reverb, fitted to the measured behaviour of a classic reverb: Mandapa, Vistara, Taranga, Dhvani, Kosha and Chatur. Some add motion or a chorus; Dhvani and Kosha can feed theirs into the reverb.
layers.spec: Mandapa · Vistara · Taranga · Dhvani · Kosha · Chatur

layers.name: Decay
layers.head: Decay band by band
layers.body: In most units the highs fade faster than the lows, as in a real room. The plots below show reverb time per band for each unit.

layers.name: Slots
layers.head: Three slots in a row
layers.body: Early, Mid and Late each hold any unit and feed the next, so you can chain a room into a hall.

layers.name: Wet EQ
layers.head: Shape the wet signal
layers.body: A four-band wet EQ after the slots, with presets and A/B to compare settings.
